description: Fork of exp234 (TinyMultiHeadLut STE backward, V2D fixed T=0.1, 1.6212 @ 8K) with argmax_noise_eps=0.005 — adds random bit-flip at low-confidence positions in the STE forward path. Tests whether noise injection ALSO helps STE backward (not just soft backward). If exp258 ≈ exp257 ≈ exp251 (~1.6026), then 'noise on low-confidence comparisons' is the universal lever and the soft backward adds nothing on top of it. If exp258 stays near exp234 (1.6212), then soft backward is needed to leverage the noise.
